items.title: Should Investors Hold CSX Stock Despite Its Higher Valuation?
items.summary: CSX faces valuation concerns and operational headwinds, but rising freight volumes, improved productivity and upbeat earnings estimates support holding the stock.

items.title: Seth Klarman, Dan Loeb and 7 Other Big Funds Sold Union Pacific Last Quarter, While 9 Bought. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNine big funds sold Union Pacific in the third quarter, including Viking Global, Seth Klarman’s Baupost Group and Dan Loeb’s Third Point, while nine bought, led by GQG Partners’ new $476 million stake. Some buyers bought other railroads too: Avala Global opened a CSX stake, and GQG opened one in Canadian Pacific Kansas City.

items.title: Union Pacific Has Raised Its Dividend for 20 Years. These 3 Railroads Offer Income
items.summary: Three railroads sit on networks no rival could ever rebuild, yet their yields look thin and one dividend has not budged in years. A pending merger and a regulator's pending ruling could decide which payout deserves a spot in your income plan.

items.title: Why Is CSX (CSX) Down 3.3% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.summary: CSX (CSX) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: iShares U.S. Transportation (IYT) Sells Union Pacific and Uber on Nov. 17
items.summary: The $2.05 billion fund sold $119.3 million of stock, cutting all 44 positions and adding none.

items.title: The Case for Small-Cap and Value Stocks
items.summary: The tech-heavy S&P 500 has underperformed small-cap value stocks this year. Given less tech exposure, cheaper valuations, and a higher yield, smaller stocks may deserve a bigger allocation in investor portfolios.

items.title: Transcontinental merger of Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern divides rail leaders
items.summary: Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern promise lasting service gains, while some rivals question the competitive consequences of their proposed combination. The post Transcontinental merger of Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern divides rail leaders appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.title: Why Goldman Sachs Thinks the Bull Market Will Keep Raging
items.summary: Strategists are forecasting that the S&P 500 will hit 8700 by the end of 2027, led by AI beneficiaries and companies buying back stock.
